test_title: PYST 06: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, P, Q, and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only D sits between B and C when counted from the left of B. P sits fourth to the right of D. R is an immediate neighbour of both P and C . Q is not an immediate neighbour of P.

How many people are sitting between D and A when counted from the left of A?
solution:
**Given**: A, B, C, D, P, Q, and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Based on the given conditions, we get the following arrangements-

1. Only D sits between B and C when counted from the left of B. P sits fourth to the right of D. From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bb00795cf41aae9b8f61b1c81e94ed46f8f61b2f3de0ceaa6072c70bf4f26a4.png] 

2. R is an immediate neighbour of both P and C. Q is not an immediate neighbour of P. From these, we get the final arrangement as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/973a47e22c43513107875750eab71fa337e2e2567f77bcc4fc452f3baafebb49.png] 

Therefore, we see that two people are sitting between D and A when counted from the left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.
